helpful: The frozen context block (band, distribution_count, cvsg_date) made the anchoring unambiguous — no need to re-derive the band.
Provisioned full-text petition and BIO were the highest-value inputs; the BIO's vehicle argument (pending state-court case) was the main downward adjustment and only its text disclosed it.
The statpack's CVSG and salience-band cuts lined up (~36% vs ~40%), which made the anchor robust.
gaps: A per-band CVSG cross-cut (grant rate among high-band petitions that were CVSG'd) would beat eyeballing two marginal cuts against each other.
A statpack cut on SG recommendation vs disposition for CVSG'd petitions would replace the largest judgment call in this cell with a measured rate.
The BIO document concatenates six respondents' filings into one 100-page text; per-filing separation (or at least the lead BIO isolated) would make targeted reading cheaper.
notes: fedcourts query with --disposition granted --era 2020s returned mostly stay-application rows rather than cert petitions; a --stage or docket-kind filter would make precedent retrieval more useful for cert cells.
